messages:
Hana (Support): Quick flag 60; Zenwell staging is returning 429s on embeddings during their onboarding run, customer paused checks. Small logs below.

Hana (Support): ```
2026-03-26T10:04:12Z embed-svc status=429 tenant=zenwell env=staging
```

doc-bot: Incident ZW-INC-700 created (priority: P2) - elevated embed errors for tenant zenwell (staging).

Drew - CSM: Drew here. Is prod affected? Customer is in trial conversion next week.

Hana (Support): Only staging, error rate ~22% for last 12m. Customer engineer said "blocked finishing onboarding".

Evan (SRE): No recent deploys. Traces show a CI spike hitting staging with many small concurrent embed requests (~100). Rate limiter tripped. Quick fix: temp bump concurrency for tenant + mute alerts.

Kara - CS Ops: I'll draft the comms and add a renewal note template. Proposed short message: "Hi Ana we saw transient embed failures in staging caused by a CI burst. We've applied a temporary stabilization and are monitoring; prod is unaffected. ETA for rollback: 45m. We can rerun onboarding checks and offer a short enablement call to optimize your test runner."

Evan (SRE): Mitigation applied at 10:11 UTC (concurrency bump). Error rate dropped to ~3% in 5m. Reversion scheduled for 10:56 UTC. Leaving incident in monitoring.

Hana (Support): Sending comms to customer and will capture reply.

Kara - CS Ops: Added renewal playbook item: "staging embed burst -> temp mitigation -> offer pairing -> log sentiment" and linked ZW-INC-700. If customer requests permanent quota, we'll open ops/pricing ticket.
